info.description: 真实会话、课程与编辑审核发布、学习追踪、代码编译队列、学习任务图、可编辑作品、私有素材和DOCX/PPTX/PDF导出。执行能力由/api/v1/capabilities与显式配置共同决定：MODEL规划需要实际模型服务，编译需要独立worker；Java/Python 运行需另行启用隔离执行；生成图像/音频/视频未启用。所有私人资源以会话归属、固定版本、输入来源、预算与租约校验；JSON请求最多262144字节/64层，素材最大8MiB。 v0.6新增私有检索评测、有限TXT/MD/DOCX批量预览与原子采集、修订差异、独立审核的精确短文本判分，以及六类持久错题交互。评测不计入学习成绩；上传解析1MiB/文件、4MiB/批，2个并发准入，24小时预览。

password.description: 至少12字符且最多72 UTF-8字节；BCrypt服务端再次按字节校验。

fullText.description: Complete verified published text when the selected concept detail exceeds the excerpt limit. Its original contentHash covers the whole text.

AttemptInput.description: CHOICE同步客观判分；CODE须有审核的正反向编译契约和独立worker，返回PENDING/GRADING后由持久事件完成评分；TEXT未配置客观判分仍503。

source.description: 有效 UTF-8 源码，不超过 32768 字节。

CompileInput.description: COMPILE_ONLY 面向 Java；COMPILE_AND_RUN 需要已授权并配置的独立运行 worker。stdin 最多 8192 UTF-8 字节。

ContextRef.description: 当前可解析GOAL/MEMORY/ARTIFACT/ATTEMPT/KNOWLEDGE_CHUNK/ASSET。ASSET必须为本人同空间READY素材并固定revision与SHA256；撤回同步使所有依赖作品失效。CONCEPT/CODE_SNAPSHOT保留未来协议。SNAPSHOT不是可直接写入作品的来源。

NotebookAction.description: 服务端校验 block.allowedActions。selectType/setParameter 必须提供 expectedStateRevision；COUNTERFACTUAL 的 submitAnswer/requestHint 也必须提供以固定已选择题目。其余动作可提供状态 CAS。Idempotency-Key 重放返回原结果，不重复写入。类型推演和导航不计独立掌握，所有 notebook 作答按辅助复练记录。

enabled.description: EXERCISE_HINTS 是内置、确定性的三级题目提示，不依赖模型或编译 worker；COMPILE_ONLY、CODE_GRADING 仅在独立 worker 配置就绪时启用。

EditorialChoiceAnswer.description: 编辑专用；SINGLE/MULTIPLE等客观题需2..8选项。SIGNATURE/REFACTOR/FILL需空选项和2..8个正反向编译检查，具体语义由服务端校验。不暴露给学习者。 READING/DIAGNOSIS可改用私有textRubric，此时options/optionIds/compileChecks必须为空；规则随题目revision审核与发布。

source.description: Probe class体内声明；固定来源最多8192 UTF-8字节。

newPassword.description: 服务端另以UTF-8字节限制最大72，改密成功后撤销全部会话。

pendingEvaluations.description: Queued or running durable retrieval evaluations across all accounts.

failedEvaluations.description: Retained evaluations in FAILED state; cancelled runs are excluded.

activeImportPreviews.description: PREVIEW batches whose expiresAt is later than generatedAt.

expiredImportPreviews.description: Overdue batches still in PREVIEW awaiting bounded cleanup; EXPIRED terminal batches are excluded.

storedEvaluationBytes.description: Sum of SQL OCTET_LENGTH for all retained evaluation snapshot, corpus manifest, case-result and report JSON payloads, including failed or cancelled partial results. Serialized database representation, not physical page allocation or the admission quota counter.

importPreviewBytes.description: Sum of SQL OCTET_LENGTH for retained original and cleaned import-item preview text in every lifecycle state, so overdue or unexpectedly uncleared residue stays observable. Committed immutable content_ingestion receipts are excluded.

StudyRunInput.description: Bounded teaching workflow. Token and wall-time budgets are enforced. This adapter has no configured pricing: maxCostMicros is carried by the generic ledger but does not estimate or cap actual provider charges. NOTEBOOK preflight requires incorrect or assisted, graded attempts.

limitBytes.description: 默认104857600（100MiB），可由部署配置降低。

ContextSnapshotInput.description: Explicit graded attempts replace the default latest-eight selection. Every reference is derived server-side from an attempt owned by the current user, in this workspace and its fixed release. Caller order is preserved. Omit the request body to retain the latest-eight behavior.

EvaluationRun.description: 列表省略逐例内容（results=[]）；详情返回已持久提交的不可变前缀。仅COMPLETED产生聚合指标和报告，FAILED/CANCELLED保留部分实际结果。

ImportBatch.description: Owner-private editorial preview. Terminal batches clear originalMarkdown and cleanedMarkdown; committed captureId remains an immutable source receipt. A preview does not publish any material.

before.description: Exact previous JSON value; arrays compare atomically. Missing values are null.

after.description: Exact new JSON value; private grading fields require active EDITOR or ADMIN.

EditorialTextRubric.description: 仅编辑/独立审核可见的短答案精确规则；正反例经NFKC、Unicode空白折叠及显式大小写规则归一后必须无冲突，不做长文或语义判分。

TextAnswerPolicy.description: 公开短答案边界：整段精确匹配，NFKC与Unicode空白折叠；按作者配置决定大小写，保留标点与词序，不暴露可接受答案或反例。maxCharacters是UTF-16单元上限。

NotebookBlockInput.description: 显式增加一个活动块并保存新作品修订。来源 block 的本人 attempt/exercise/evidence 固定，allowedActions 由服务端产生；REPAIR_DIFF 与 EXPERT_HELP 配置从来源推导。TYPE_FLOW 默认有限候选；COUNTERFACTUAL 要求当前发布同题族审核题；REVIEW_LINKS 要求真实复习或本人同空间当前作品。
